Please note that resources need to be Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and
Reusable (FAIR) to be incorporated in ariadne.

**Resource name, description and scope:** why is this resource important, and
what feature mappings does it provide?

**URL to resource website**:

**Resource type:**
-[ ] Zenodo record
-[ ] Online file directory
-[ ] SPARQL endpoint
-[ ] RESTful API

online file directory ([example](https://current.geneontology.org/)), SPARQL
endpoint ([example](https://sparql.uniprot.org/)) or RESTful API
([example](https://www.kegg.jp/kegg/rest/keggapi.html)):**

**For this feature, I would like to:**
-[ ] contribute myself
-[ ] get some guidance and contribute myself
-[ ] have it handled by the team
